text:
Type: high-back wingback armchair
Use: relaxing, reading; living room, library, bedroom
Style: mid-century modern, classic, contemporary
Materials: velvet upholstery, padded frame, attached neck cushion, solid wood legs in a warm brown stain
Colors: deep black, warm medium brown wood
Shape: tall upright back with subtle wings and a half-moon headrest pillow, rounded flared arms, thick seat cushion, four tapered wooden legs, tailored and slim, medium visual weight
Feel: elegant, dramatic, refined, cozy
Goes with: walnut or oak, brass accents, warm rugs, grey or green walls; mid-century or classic living rooms

product.name: STOCKHOLM
product.description: This chair is made from moulded high resilience foam that provides comfort and support  and keeps its shape for years.
